title: Agent cards
summary: One unit of agent work (a run, a task, a job) as a card that keeps working while folded: a status chip, one line of activity, a decision on the card, and the composer's levels on a strip.
purpose: AgentCard and AgentChat over a scripted agent: one card per state (queued, running, needs you, done, failed) with three agents in three colours, plus a task card (the same card with a meta). Folded, a card shows the agent's colour dot, a title, a status chip and one line; a decision the agent waits for shows on the folded card. The strip on its lower border is one ladder, a step at a time: chat bubble, composer, a small tray (the conversation and its field), the whole chat; Dock at every step.

try.label: Open the chat of a finished run
Open the chat of a host's own card

fixture.usage: <AgentCard controller={controller} agent={{ name: 'Ledger', color: 'chart-1' }} title="Match the January payments" status={{ label: 'Done', tone: 'success' }} meta={<>Assignee, due date…</>} dock={dockElement} />

notes: Below the five states, two cards show a host that draws its own card: it passes `header` and `children` (a card opened in place), a `slot` for the tray inside its body, and no controller until the first tap (`onChatRequest`); the second shows the quiet unread dot with no chat yet. The cards stay mounted while folded: the running card keeps updating its line, and the needs-you card shows the kit's approval card on the folded card, with a warning ring and no auto-expand. The colour of an agent is one of the theme's chart tokens; the header is tinted from it. The strip is the composer's own.
